description: Build Optimization and Service Worker Enhancement - Enhance vite.config.js with production optimizations (preload/prefetch), enhance the existing service worker for better offline caching with versioned cache busting, and add build analysis documentation.
steps: Update vite.config.js to add production optimizations: terser minification options (drop console.log in production), asset inlining threshold (4kb), CSS code splitting, source map generation for production (hidden sourcemaps), and preload directives for critical chunks via modulePreload config.

Enhance public/sw.js with improved caching strategies: versioned cache names (use APP_VERSION), runtime caching for API calls (network-first with 5s timeout fallback to cache), stale-while-revalidate for fonts/images, cache size limits (max 50 entries per cache, auto-evict oldest), and a message handler for 'SKIP_WAITING' to support update-available UI.
Create src/components/layout/UpdateNotification.jsx - a small banner/toast component that detects when a new service worker is waiting and prompts the user to refresh for updates.
Update index.html to add resource hints: preconnect to fonts.googleapis.com (already there), dns-prefetch hints, meta description, Open Graph tags for the app.

Create src/lib/buildInfo.js - exports build metadata (version from package.json, build timestamp set at build time via define in vite config, git commit hash placeholder). Update vite.config.js to inject __BUILD_TIMESTAMP__ and __APP_VERSION__ via define.
Create src/lib/__tests__/buildInfo.test.js verifying the buildInfo module exports expected shape.
acceptance_criteria: vite.config.js includes production optimizations (terser, modulePreload, cssCodeSplit)
public/sw.js has versioned cache, runtime caching for APIs, stale-while-revalidate for assets, size limits
UpdateNotification component renders update prompt when new SW is waiting
index.html has resource hints and meta tags
buildInfo.js exports version and build timestamp
Build succeeds: `npx vite build` completes without errors
verification: Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vite build` and confirm it succeeds
Run `unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest run` and confirm all tests pass
